title: Billy Sims BBQ: How OU's Heisman Winner Built a Restaurant Chain
question: When did Billy Sims open his first Billy Sims BBQ restaurant?
answer: Billy Sims, OU's 1978 Heisman winner, co-founded Billy Sims BBQ with partner Jeff Jackson; the first restaurant opened in Tulsa in 2004.
summary: Heisman winner Billy Sims (OU 1975-79) co-founded Billy Sims BBQ with Jeff Jackson, opening the first one in Tulsa in 2004 before growing to 50-plus units.
body: Billy Sims gave Sooner fans plenty to cheer about between 1975 and 1979. After an injury-shortened start, he exploded in 1978, leading the nation with 1,762 rushing yards and 20 touchdowns to win the Heisman Trophy. He finished second in the 1979 voting and left Norman as OU's career rushing leader with 4,118 yards.

The Detroit Lions made him the first overall pick in the 1980 draft, and he was a star in Detroit until a knee injury in 1984 ended his career. For many Oklahomans, though, the name Billy Sims now brings to mind something else: barbecue.

Sims co-founded Billy Sims BBQ with business partner Jeff Jackson, who serves as the company's CEO. Their first restaurant opened in 2004 in The Farm shopping center in Tulsa. The fast-casual concept smokes its meats daily on site, using pecan wood, and serves brisket, ribs, pork, chicken, turkey and bologna alongside classic sides.

After a handful of company-owned restaurants proved the idea, the partners began franchising in 2009. Franchise listings report that the brand opened 11 restaurants in 2014 alone, including stadium outlets, and by 2019 the Tulsa-based chain had passed 50 locations in six states.
It is a fitting second act for a back who always ran downhill: the same name that once filled the box score at Owen Field now hangs over smokers across the region.
